protocol.instructions: Set a timer for 10:00. At the start of each minute, complete prescribed reps with clean form, then rest for the remainder.

exercises.name: Two-Handed Kettlebell Swings
exercises.trail_benefit: Builds posterior chain endurance & glute drive for steep climbs

exercises.name: Single-Leg Deadlifts
exercises.trail_benefit: Single-leg stability, ankle resilience, hamstring strain prevention

exercises.name: Goblet Reverse Lunges
form_cues: Step back cleanly, keep front knee over toes
exercises.trail_benefit: Eccentric quad strength & braking power for steep technical descents

exercises.name: Suitcase March
form_cues: Lift opposite knee with controlled core
exercises.trail_benefit: Anti-lateral flexion, core stiffness, and balance under fatigue

exercises.name: Kettlebell Halos
form_cues: Hold KB horns bottoms-up near chest
exercises.trail_benefit: Thoracic mid-back mobility and shoulder stability for pack/vest carrying

rules.name: Consistency Over Intensity
rules.text: Never push to failure. Leave 2-3 reps in the tank on every set.

rules.name: Timing
rules.text: Perform right after a run while warm, or as a standalone session. Avoid right before hard speed work.

rules.name: Peak Volume Mod
rules.text: During high-mileage or vertical gain weeks, drop Swings to 10 reps and Lunges to 4/side.
